head: working-tree
subject: restore the Windows portable cross-compile gate
change: The x86_64-windows-gnu test-compile target failed with nine errors in netz-owned test fixtures: POSIX-only setsockopt/sendto/recvfrom/poll calls and fake socket handles written as the integer 0. Added src/internal/test_socket.zig, which returns a valid std.Io.net.Socket.Handle for either an integer-descriptor or opaque-pointer target, and replaced the fake stream literals. POSIX-only tests now return error.SkipZigTest at comptime on Windows, and BlockedOutput guards its setsockopt/saturate bodies. No production protocol code changed.

x86_64-windows-gnu.before: 9 compile errors in POSIX-only test fixtures

aarch64-macos-none.reason: pinned Vort emits linksection(".vort_br_counted_context"), which LLVM rejects for Mach-O (a segment and section separated by a comma are required). This is an external dependency limitation, not a netz test error.

notes: The Linux and Windows portable targets now pass. The macOS targets reach the Vort dependency and fail inside LLVM before netz tests are compiled; updating that would require a Vort change and a new pinned revision. The fake-handle helper is test-only and is never dereferenced.
